subject: Q2 pipeline hygiene: stage confirmations + leadership pack intake
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Health RevOps <revops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 pipeline hygiene: stage confirmations + leadership pack intake

Team,

We need to close the loop on stage updates and commit confirmations for Q2 so I can assemble the leadership review pack next week. Please do the following by EOD Tuesday (2027-03-30):

- Open the attached Q2_commit_tracker.xlsx and update every active opportunity assigned to you with: stage, best estimate commit date, ARR, and whether sales is committing this quarter (YES/NO).
- Mark any deals that require legal or procurement redlines in the "flags" column and add a one-line note.
- If you expect to pull or push a commit, place the expected delta next to the ARR.

Key notes: leadership wants the pack by Thu 2027-04-01 10:00 PT. I will pull the tracker on Wed morning and drop the slides into the leadership_pack_template.pptx. If you have a high-priority ask (exceptions, credit requests, or a forecast variance >20%), copy me and Vanessa and call out in bold in the tracker.

Attachments: Q2_commit_tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet), leadership_pack_template.pptx (pptx)

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

Jonas —

Acknowledged, I'll update my book by EOD Tuesday. Quick question: for HS-4938 (Acme Health) do you want the commit flagged as contingent on SOC-2 evidence delivery? Procurement asked me to note the dependency explicitly.

I'll add a comment in the "flags" column and set commit = NO until SOC-2 snapshot is confirmed. If we get the evidence before Tues I'll flip it to YES and note the source.

Marissa

1) HS-4938 (Acme Health)

   - We should mark commit = NO (pending SOC-2 evidence). Marissa, thanks for owning that note.

If anyone needs me to run numbers or add a line to the leadership slide, ping me — I can take the ARR rollup for the west region.

Thanks for the quick turn, Marissa / Karthik. Final notes and timeline: 

- I'll pull the tracker snapshot Wed 2027-03-31 08:00 PT. Please make sure any late edits are timestamped in the comments so I can reconcile changes.
- Vanessa — can you validate the ARR math and surface any large negative deltas for the exec summary by Wed 12:00 PT?
- Grace — please assemble the "Top risks" slide in the leadership pack; use the "flags" column as the source of truth and include 1-line mitigation for each risk.

Linking the working folder: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/drive/folders/1QbrPack
HubSpot reference: HS-4938

I'll compile the slides and circulate a final draft Thu morning for leadership review. If we have any outstanding SOC/Procurement blockers that materially change the commit, we'll include an exceptions appendix.

Appreciate the fast follow — this will keep Q2 projections clean for finance.

Jonas
